original.statement: In the source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1 schema of helmcharts.source.toolkit.fluxcd.io, status.artifact.digest is now a required field, and HelmChart objects that omit it are rejected.

decision.reason: I compared the v2.6.4 and v2.7.0 install manifests [ev-782bc47d120d] [ev-c2c6c790d6b2]. A deterministic check on them confirms that status.artifact.digest is in the HelmChart schema in both releases. It also confirms the field is newly required only in the source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1 schema. That proves the subject, including version=v1 because the change applies to one API version, and the now-required change type.
